title: Unity CLI Extension Descriptor
description: Describes an optional capability pack (extension) for the Unity CLI. Extensions depend on optional Unity packages and provide additional tools.

id.description: Extension identifier, e.g. 'probuilder'. Must be unique.

description.description: One-paragraph explanation of what the extension provides.

source.description: Origin: 'built-in' (declared in core metadata) or 'package' (separate npm/Unity package).

providesTools.description: Tools provided by this extension (dotted names).

requiresUnityPackages.description: Unity packages required for this extension to work.

installMode.description: How the extension is installed: 'auto' (detected during init) or 'manual' (explicit install command).

copyRoot.description: Unity-side copy root. New extensions use extension-directory under Packages/com.unity_cli/Extensions/<id>; unitypkg is legacy.

installCommand.description: CLI command to install this extension.

equivalentMcpGroup.description: Mapping to equivalent unity-mcp group name, for parity tracking.

nextActions.description: Suggested next actions after listing/describing the extension.
